logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Horizontal comparison bar chart for WO-01: acceptance-run energy in kWh for pump modules P1 (56), P2 (12), P3 (52) and P4 (58), all measured on the same fixed flow and head duty. P2 is rendered green as the lowest-energy qualifying module with a dashed horizontal reference line at 12 kWh; P4 is highlighted orange with a callout reading "P4 — only zero-defect module, flagged for audit before award". Each bar is annotated beneath with its quality index and defect count (q84/d4, q97/d1, q80/d3, q81/d0). A short caption notes the common test basis and that P4's robustness strength is offset by the largest energy figure. Serif typography, light background, gridlines at 10 kWh intervals.
